evidence.reason: qemu_command interpolates the resolved run path directly into each QEMU -drive option string. QEMU parses commas inside option values as option delimiters, so a run directory such as probe,local produces malformed file=... options even though preparation may have succeeded. Nothing in the supplied function rejects comma-containing paths, so this is an existing implementation defect in the drive-argument builder; escaping the QEMU option value or rejecting such run paths before preparation is a routine correctness fix.
